Attachment: IBRD Guangdong Agricultural Product Quality Safety Improvement (Demonstration) Project Task Outline for Third-Party Consulting Services for Agricultural Product Quality Safety Liability Insurance

 

 

IBRD Guangdong Agricultural Product Quality Safety Improvement (Demonstration) Project

Task Outline for Third-Party Consulting Services for Agricultural Product Quality Safety Liability Insurance

To promote the organization and implementation of the innovative full value chain agricultural product quality safety liability insurance model within the IBRD Guangdong Agricultural Product Quality Safety Improvement (Demonstration) Project (hereinafter referred to as the "World Bank Loan Project"), and to ensure the successful completion of the project according to its objectives and plans, the Guangdong Provincial Center for Agricultural Product Quality Safety (Guangdong Green Food Development Center) intends to hire a third-party consulting service institution for the insurance innovation sub-project to provide full-process supervision, management services, and professional support.

I.Project Background

In order to thoroughly implement the decisions and arrangements of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on strengthening food safety work, to accelerate the improvement of food quality and safety levels, and to promote the innovative development of the food industry. Following a request from the Chinese government, the World Bank's Board of Executive Directors approved a loan of $400 million to China's Food Safety Demonstration Project in March 2021. The loan is intended to assist China in strengthening food safety management at the national and local levels and reducing safety risks in the food value chain. The project is led by the State Administration for Market Regulation and the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, with Shandong and Guangdong as pilot provinces, among which Guangdong Province received a loan amount of $260 million. In December 2023, the Ministry of Finance of China officially signed the loan agreement for the China Food Safety Demonstration Project with the World Bank, which officially came into effect in March 2024.

The Guangdong project includes four components: (1) the construction of agricultural product quality safety supervision mechanisms; (2) the construction of agricultural product quality safety supervision capabilities; (3) the construction of full value chain improvement projects for agricultural products; and (4) the construction of project implementation management and performance evaluation mechanisms.

The third component, the construction of full value chain improvement projects for agricultural products, will support the demonstration of food safety improvements on selected value chains by helping new types of agricultural operators, rural collective economic organizations, and farmers along the full value chain. In addition to direct investment for facility upgrades, this component will also pilot the innovation of full value chain agricultural product quality safety liability insurance, implement a new management and operation model of "information-based smart supervision + agricultural product quality safety insurance services + agricultural product quality safety traceability (quality certificate)", and introduce third-party service institutions that assist in quality assurance and risk reduction and supervision of food safety.

The full value chain agricultural product quality safety liability insurance, driven by the government and operated through market mechanisms by insurance companies and third-party institutions, aims to create an integrated service model for pre-emptive, ongoing, and post-incident risk warning, risk control, and risk transfer, which integrates standardized technical services and insurance services. By fully leveraging the synergy of social resources, it will break through the regulatory links in the full value chain of agricultural products, achieve effective linkage of agricultural product quality safety risk regulation throughout the chain, and forming a more effective new model of social co-governance for agricultural product quality safety. This will promote the construction of agricultural product brands and high-quality development.

The budget for premium subsidies for the insurance innovation sub-project is $30 million. Project funds account for 80% of the insurance premium, with the insured entities bearing 20% themselves. The pilot plan is tentatively set for 1 year, with a full-scale promotion in the five pilot cities after conditions are ripe, and a provincial promotion after mid-term adjustments. The insurance period is up to 1 year, with annual renewals. Insured entities purchase full value chain agricultural product quality safety risk control services and related liability insurance protection services from insurance companies.

II.Purpose of Services

This project aims to hire a third-party consulting service institution to provide full-process professional services and training for the Guangdong Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs and various project implementation units in implementing the agricultural product quality safety liability insurance project. It will also supervise and manage the implementation of innovative insurance models, complete the work assigned by the provincial PMO, ensure that insurance products from insurance companies meet requirements, and that insurance underwriting and claims comply with relevant laws and regulations. It will follow up with insured entities to ensure they implement according to project requirements, ensuring the smooth implementation and effectiveness of the insurance model.

III.Scope and Service Time

(1) Scope of Services. The pilot scope includes selecting one pilot county (city, district) in each of the five cities of Guangzhou, Foshan, Jiangmen, Huizhou, and Zhaoqing; the pilot plan is tentatively set for 1 year, with a full-scale promotion in the five pilot cities after conditions are ripe, and a provincial promotion after mid-term adjustments. The supported products include lychee, pork, vegetables, aquatic products, and pre-cooked dishes, among other varieties.

(2) Service Time. The implementation period of this contract is 3 years, calculated from the date of agreement signing date.

IV. Service Content

The main service content includes (but not limited to):

1.Assist in formulating management methods, operation manuals, guidelines, and other systems for the agricultural product quality safety liability insurance sub-project.

(1) The third-party consulting service institution collects, organizes, and compiles various systemic documents and submits them to the Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs for review and confirmation.

(2) The management method includes project objectives, project management-related roles and responsibilities, service entity assessment standards, project management processes, project management documents and templates, complaint and suggestion management methods, etc.; the operation manual includes insurance protection plans, insurance service plans, information system implementation plans, project information and data management plans; various operational processes include the process of determining entities for the database, insurance application process, claims process, premium subsidy settlement process, etc.

(3) The third-party consulting service institution will also provide daily task operation guidance documents for different entities based on various systemic documents.

2.Provide and operate an information platform for the management of the agricultural product quality safety liability insurance sub-project (including an insured entity management module and a system interface with insurance companies).

The information platform will include the following functional modules, which can be adjusted according to project needs:

(1) Information on entities in the database: registration and review of insured entities;

  (2) Insurance application function: interface with the core system of the project's insurance company to collect and store insurance application information, premium information, policy information, etc.;

(3) Insurance claims function: interface with the core system of the project's insurance company to collect and store claims information, etc.;

(4) Insurance service function: collect and send inspection and spot check information, risk warning;

(5) Agricultural product traceability information: interface with existing traceability platforms to extend the safety chain;

(6) Insurance training: collect and record training and learning records of insured entities;

 (7) Resources and sharing: including laws and regulations, industry standards, expert suggestions (how to plant better, how to use pesticides), new technology news;

 (8) Additional functions may be added as needed, such as interfaces with online retail or wholesale bulk procurement platforms.

3.Assist in formulating the entry standard of the insured subject library, screen compliance subjects and products, establish and manage the insured subject project library, and supervise the implementation of the data and information related to the quality and safety of agricultural products submitted by the subject in the library.

(1) Assist in establishing standards for the database of insured entities. The standards include qualification requirements, business requirements, database entry process, qualification documents, principles for entering and leaving the database, and collection and storage of entity information.

(2) During the project implementation, the third-party consulting service institution should manage the data of entities in the database through the information platform.

4.Assist the Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs in selecting insurance companies, including but not limited to preparing bidding documents, and train insurance companies after the project starts.

5. Participate in formulating the scope, compensation standards, and procedures for innovative insurance products, and review the insurance terms of various insurance companies.

Assist insurance companies in designing new product insurance exemplary terms to meet the management objectives of the insurance sub-project and to truly meet the risk management needs of entities in the database.

 

 

  1. Supervise insurance purchases, verification of insurance types, claims payments, traceability of claims, recall or harmless treatment of non-compliant agricultural products, etc., and establish accounting books.
  1. Collect and store insurance application information and insurance incident information of entities in the database through the information platform.
  2. Regularly review policy and premium materials, spot check the insurance application status of entities in the database, and ensure the effectiveness of policies.
  3. Regularly review insurance incident claim materials, spot check the compensation status of entities in the database, and ensure the insurance protection and service status.

7.Review the premium subsidy application materials submitted by insurance companies and establish accounting books;

The third-party consulting service institution assists in establishing the "Insurance premium subsidy funds declaration conditions materials and procedures" management method. Conduct review and record-keeping of application entity premium subsidy qualifications, and review and registration of premium subsidy application materials to ensure that the recorded information is verifiable, traceable, and accountable.

8.Supervise the compliance of various insurance companies with the "Insurance Law" and the regulations of National Financial Regulatory Administration; monitor the execution of insurance companies through surveys of insured entities and conduct periodic assessments; regularly organize project work meetings to promote project implementation and regularly report to the Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs.

The third-party consulting service institution will regularly update due diligence information on cooperating insurance companies throughout the project service period. The content of the investigation is consistent with the selection criteria for insurers.

9.Supervise insurance companies to effectively fulfill their full-process service responsibilities for the quality safety of agricultural products and compensation responsibilities for non-compliant agricultural products.

The third-party consulting service institution provides regular analytical reports on the insurance companies' coverage and claims handling, including the amount of insurance, the amount of claims, the timeliness of claims, and the adequacy of claims.

10.Assist in formulating comprehensive evaluation methods and standards for insurance companies and third-party quality and safety testing and evaluation service institutions; complete the phased evaluation work for the above institutions, and form semi-annual and annual comprehensive evaluation reports in July of the current year and January of the following year, respectively;

The third-party consulting service institution establishes a "Comprehensive Performance Scoring System," creating operable service evaluation content and quantifiable scoring standards based on different dimensions such as service time, service frequency, service satisfaction, and the completion of promised services according to the service characteristics of different institutions. The aforementioned institutions must effectively assume their main responsibilities and carry out effective work according to standards and commitments; the third-party consulting service institution regularly conducts comprehensive evaluations of the service content and outcomes of the aforementioned institutions, fully supervising and guiding the continuous improvement of service levels.

  1. Assist in organizing the phased evaluation and annual acceptance of the liability insurance sub-project, and complete evaluation reports and acceptance reports.

The third-party consulting service institution shall provide monthly reports, quarterly reports, semi-annual reports, and annual reports.

12.Coordinate with the government, insurance companies, and service entities to share data on risk forecasting and analysis results.

13.Collect claims and complaint information.

Design the fields for accident reporting information, design the claims submission process, and provide guidance for insured entities on claims services. Collect complaints from insured entities and establish accounting books.

Responsible for mediating disputes between policyholders and insurance institutions, handling disputes over insurance services, and safeguarding the legal rights and interests of all parties involved.

14.Participate in the design of insurance logos for insured entities' products to enhance consumer confidence and promote the construction of brand value chains.

Design the style of insurance labels and information systems. Integrate traceability information systems to increase consumer confidence in the safety of products from entities in the database, and enhance the market competitiveness of these products.

Assist in promoting the safety value of agricultural products from entities in the database to market circulation entities (retail and wholesale), actively recommending these products. Help entities in the database to increase their commercial credibility and product competitiveness, and support the premium and sales of high-quality and safe agricultural products.

  1. Assist in the bidding and tendering work related to the insurance sub-project.

Provide professional consulting for various bidding and tendering documents, such as: research on the qualifications of insurance companies, sharing of insurance market information; sorting out the insurance application process, system interface, reconciliation, and policy issuance process; review and consultation on policy, terms, endorsements, and other contractual content in the bidding documents; interpretation and explanation of policy content and terms in the bidding documents.

  1. Monitor the completion of insurance satisfaction indicators.

The third-party consulting service institution conducts satisfaction surveys of insurance companies and collects the needs and suggestions of insured entities.

V.Expected Objectives

The project duration is 36 months. Within this scope of responsibility, the project aims to assist government departments in tracking and managing the project, coordinating the work of all project participants, and providing assurance for insured entities to enjoy full value chain agricultural product quality safety liability insurance services, thereby enhancing the level of food safety in specific value chains.

The "Pilot Implementation Plan for Full Value Chain Agricultural Product Quality Safety Liability Insurance" serves as the procedural document guiding this project. The third-party consulting service institution should regularly collect and provide relevant project data to the provincial project office; when necessary, assist project monitoring and evaluation personnel in verifying the data. Regularly and irregularly inspect the scale and quality of insurance company services, and verify premium subsidy applications submitted by insurance companies to avoid the risk of insurance fraud.

VI. Deliverables and Timeframes

The third-party consulting service institution provides semi-annual and annual reports on the implementation of liability insurance (in both Chinese and English) to the provincial project management office.

  1. The deliverables include, but are not limited to, the following information:
  1. The number of insured entities in the project database;
  2. The number of insurance policies issued and analysis of insurance status;
  3. Analysis of insurance coverage and amounts;
  4. Evaluation of insurance companies' project compensation status;
  5. The number of premium subsidies issued and the amount of funds;
  6. The batch and quantity of non-compliant agricultural products, compensation funds involved, recall and disposal status, and actual compensation funds;
  7. Basic information on the full-process services of insurance companies: dispatched technical personnel, number of served enterprises, investment in technical services, specific activities and effects (including levels of agricultural product quality safety, product sales volume, brand building, insurance satisfaction), etc.;
  8. Basic information of the policyholders: the project name of the agricultural product quality safety activities undertaken by the policyholder, product variety, insured amount, contact information, geographical location, and a brief description, etc.
  1. Delivery Time of Results
    (1) The semi-annual report on the implementation of the safety liability insurance shall be prepared and submitted to the Provincial World Bank Office for review before August 1st of each year and February 1st of the following year.
  1. The annual report on the implementation of the safety liability insurance shall be prepared and submitted to the Provincial World Bank Office for review before March 1st of the following year.

VII. Response Time

The response time of the third-party consulting service institution shall not exceed 24 hours.

VIII. Qualification Requirements for the Third-Party Consulting Service Institution

(1) Possess the ability to independently bear civil liability; have a good business reputation and a sound financial and accounting system; have the necessary equipment and professional technical capabilities to fulfill the contract; have a good record of paying taxes and social security funds in accordance with the law. There should be no significant violations of the law, no adverse records, no negative social impact, and no serious complaints from project owners in similar work tasks;

(2) Have the qualifications for risk management consulting services related to insurance;

(3) Have experience and performance in risk management consulting services for agricultural product/food insurance;

(4) Be familiar with the local conditions of the service area;

(5) Consulting firms may submit letters of interest jointly with other companies to enhance their qualifications, but they should clearly indicate that such a joint submission is in the form of a consortium and/or subcontracting. If a consortium form is selected, and if appointed, each member of the consortium shall jointly and severally be liable for the entire contract.

procnotices.contact_address: Av. Javier Prado Oeste 2442, Magdalena del Mar
procnotices.contact_organization: Servicio Nacional Forestal y de Fauna Silvestre
procnotices.notice_text:
INVITACIÓN A PRESENTAR COTIZACIONES
(Servicios de Solicitud de Cotizaciones)
REPÚBLICA DEL PERÚ
Donación: Carta de Acuerdo N° TF C9228-PE - “Donación para la preparación del programa de inversión "Desarrollo sostenible de la producción forestal y restauración de los ecosistemas degradados en diez (10) departamentos del Perú” (PRISFOR)”.
SDC N° 001-2026-MIDAGRI-SERFOR-DE
El Gobierno del Perú y el Banco Internacional de Reconstrucción y Fomento (BIRF), suscribieron la Carta de Acuerdo N.° TF C9228-PE, mediante la cual, se otorga la donación para financiar la preparación del programa de inversión “Desarrollo Sostenible de la Producción Forestal y Restauración de los ecosistemas degradados en diez (10) departamentos del Perú”, y se propone utilizar una parte de los fondos para la contratación del servicio “Operador Logístico que realice la Planificación, Organización y Ejecución del Taller Macrorregional de Socialización, Involucramiento y Validación del Programa de Inversión de Desarrollo Sostenible de la Producción Forestal y Restauración de los Ecosistemas degradados a realizarse en Junín (Satipo)”
Los servicios de no consultoría (“los servicios”) son requeridos con el fin de contar con un operador logístico, que será responsable de coordinar e implementar las acciones requeridas para la ejecución, convocatoria y coordinación interinstitucional, necesarias para la realización de los talleres de socialización y validación del PRISFOR.
En este contexto, el Servicio Nacional Forestal y de Fauna Silvestre (SERFOR) responsable de la formulación del proyecto, invita a una persona natural o jurídica elegible a enviar su cotización para el servicio solicitado. Los interesados deberán proporcionar información que indique que están cualificados para suministrar el servicio.
Los criterios para la selección, son los siguientes:
● El operador logístico no deberá estar inhabilitado o suspendido para contratar con el Estado.
● Registro Único de Contribuyente - activo y habilitado.
● No tener vínculo de parentesco dentro del cuarto grado de consanguinidad y segundo de afinidad con funcionarios y directivos del SERFOR.
● El operador logístico deberá acreditar la ejecución mínima de (03) tres eventos logísticos relacionados a organización de eventos de similares al presente requerimiento efectuada a Entidades públicas y/o privadas de preferencia en los sectores forestales y/o ambientales.
o Se considera servicios similares a servicios logísticos para la realización y/u organización y/o producción de actividades y/o eventos para entidades públicas y/o privadas a nivel nacional y/o regional y/o local; y/o servicios que hayan contemplado la implementación de talleres, reuniones, capacitaciones y similares.
La cotización es requerida bajo el párrafo 6.7 de las Regulaciones de Adquisiciones para Prestatarios en Proyectos de Inversión del Banco Mundial Setiembre 2025 (“Regulaciones de Adquisiciones”). Los formularios para presentar su cotización los podrán encontrar en nuestra página web o podrán ser solicitados al correo electrónico indicado en líneas abajo.
Los interesados por favor tomar en cuenta las condiciones establecidas sobre conflicto de interés detalladas en el párrafo 3.13 de las “Regulaciones de Adquisiciones”.

La persona natural o jurídica interesadas pueden obtener más información solicitándola a través del siguiente correo electrónico: ogpp44@serfor.gob.pe señalando en el asunto del correo: “Expresión de Interés - SDC N° 001-2026-MIDAGRI-SERFOR-DE”.
Las expresiones de interés deberán ser remitidas a los siguientes correos electrónicos: eromero@serfor.gob.pe y ogpp44@serfor.gob.pe a más tardar hasta las 11:59pm (hora peruana) del 20 de mayo de 2026.
Atentamente.

Servicio Nacional Forestal y de Fauna Silvestre (SERFOR)
Dirección: Av. Javier Prado Oeste 2442, Magdalena del Mar
Urb. Orrantia, Magdalena del Mar – Lima 17
Teléfono: (511) 225-9005
Correo electrónico: eromero@serfor.gob.pe y ogpp44@serfor.gob.pe
www.gob.pe/serfor
www.gob.pe/midagri

recrutement d'un consultant individuel chargé du développement des compétences en protocole, étiquette professionnelle et rédaction administrative

  • Être titulaire d’un Master (Bac+5) en communication, administration publique, relations publiques ou disciplines connexes ;

procnotices.project_name: Djibouti Skills Development for Employment Project
procnotices.bid_description: Recrutement d’un cabinet pour l’appui à la structuration des écosystèmes sectoriels et au renforcement de la gouvernance de la formation professionnelle dans les secteurs des énergies renouvelables et de la mécanique automobile
procnotices.contact_address: Service de Gestion des Projets au Ministère de l'Education Nationale de la Republique de Djibouti
procnotices.notice_text:
MINISTÈRE DE L’ÉDUCATION NATIONALE ET DE LA FORMATION PROFESSIONNELLE

PROJET DE DÉVELOPPEMENT DES COMPÉTENCES POUR L’EMPLOI (SKILLS) - PROJET N°175483

AVIS DE MANIFESTATION D’INTÉRÊT POUR LE RECRUTEMENT D’UN CABINET DE CONSULTANTS

Le Gouvernement de Djibouti à travers le Ministère de l’Éducation Nationale et de la Formation Professionnelle (MENFOP) et le Ministère du Travail chargé de la Formalisation et de la Protection Sociale (MTFPS) a reçu un financement de l’association internationale de développement (IDA), le projet  intitulé « Projet de Développement des Compétences pour l’Emploi à Djibouti (PDCE) » et a l’intention d’utiliser une partie du montant de ce financement pour effectuer les paiements au titre du contrat de service pour le recrutement d’un cabinet de consultants pour l’appui à la structuration des écosystèmes sectoriels et au renforcement de la gouvernance de la formation professionnelle dans les secteurs des énergies renouvelables et de la mécanique automobile.

Les Cabinets de consultants (« Consultants ») spécialisés dans ce domaine et intéressés par cet avis, sont invités à retirer les Termes de Référence (TdRs)  à l’adresse internet mentionnée ci-dessous.

Les cabinets doivent présenter les qualifications suivantes :

  • Expérience confirmée (au moins 10 ans) dans la structuration de filières économiques, idéalement dans les secteurs des énergies renouvelables et/ou de la mécanique automobile, ainsi que dans l’appui à la création et au développement d’associations professionnelles et d’organisations sectorielles.
  • Solide connaissance des enjeux de l’emploi et de la formation professionnelle en Afrique, avec une bonne compréhension du contexte économique de Djibouti, notamment des dynamiques des PME et des chaînes de valeur locales.
  • Expertise avérée en diagnostic organisationnel et sectoriel, en ingénierie de formation et en analyse des besoins en compétences, incluant la conception de référentiels métiers et de dispositifs de formation adaptés au marché du travail.
  • Compétences confirmées en animation de dialogue multi-acteurs, incluant les acteurs publics, privés, organisations professionnelles et partenaires techniques et financiers, avec une capacité démontrée à faciliter des processus participatifs inclusifs.

Le cabinet devra mobiliser une équipe pluridisciplinaire capable de répondre aux exigences du projet dans les délais impartis.

Il est porté à l’attention des Consultants que les dispositions du paragraphe 3.15 à 3.16 des « Règlements de Passation de Marchés applicables aux Emprunteurs sollicitant le financement de projets d’investissements (FPI)» révisé en Février 2025, relatives aux règles de la Banque Mondiale en matière de conflit d’intérêts sont applicables.

Les Consultants seront sélectionné selon la méthode de « Sélection Fondée sur les Qualifications du Consultant (SQC) » telle que décrite dans les paragraphes 7.11 et 7.12 des règlements de passation de marchés de la Banque Mondiale, Sixième édition, Version 2025, notamment la Section VII. Méthodes de sélection agréées aux services de consultants.

Conditions d’éligibilités :

Les fonctionnaires ou conventionnés nationaux, actuellement en fonction ne sont pas éligibles mais les enseignants de l’université de Djibouti et les chercheurs du CERD peuvent y participer.

Les consultants intéressés peuvent obtenir des informations supplémentaires à l’adresse, ci-dessous et aux heures suivantes : du dimanche au jeudi, de 8h00 à 17h00 (GMT+3).

Les manifestations d’intérêt des consultants doivent être accompagnées de leurs Curriculum Vitae (CV), de diplômes, portfolio des expériences antérieures et des  pièces justificatives attestant de leurs expériences professionnelles à savoir attestations de service fait, certificat de travail ou tout autre document officiel permettant de valider les missions réalisées. Ces documents doivent être transmis par courriel ou en personne à l’adresse  ci-dessous au plus tard le Mardi 09 Juin 2026 à 14h00. Ces pièces sont indispensables pour vérifier la conformité de votre profil avec les exigences de la mission.

  1. Adresse internet pour retrait des TdRs : contacter l’unité de gestion des projets du MENFOP au menfoprojets@gmail.com.
  2. Adresse de dépôt des candidatures : Secrétariat du Service de Gestion des Projets (SGP), Boulevard de la République, B.P. 2043 Djibouti, Tél : +253 21 35 14 20; E-mail : menfoprojets@gmail.com ; msalehnio@gmail.com ; abdourahman_444@yahoo.fr

procnotices.notice_text:
REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(CONSULTING SERVICES – FIRMS SELECTION)

KYRGYZ REPUBLIC

CLIMATE RESILIENT WATER SERVICES PROJECT (CRWSP)

CREDIT NO.: 7081-KG

GRANT NO.: E009-KG

Assignment Title: Selection of a consulting company for Establishment of a Laboratory Data Management Information System

Reference No. (as per Procurement Plan): CREWSP/CS/C.2.3/CQS/1

The Kyrgyz Republic has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Сlimate Resilient Water Services Project (CRWSP) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The consultancy services ("Services") shall include the establishment of a Laboratory Data Management Information System.

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment are attached to this Request for Expressions of Interest.

The Water Resources Service under the Ministry of Water Resources, Agriculture and Processing Industry of the Kyrgyz Republic now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. The shortlisting criteria are:

  • At least 5 (five) years of overall experience in the field of information systems development;
  • At least two (2) successfully completed contracts for information systems of similar complexity within the last three years;
  • Experience in developing information systems for government agencies in the Kyrgyz Republic.

Interested Consultants should refer to paragraphs 3.14, 3.16 and 3.17 of Section III of the Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrower November 2020 (the "Procurement Regulations") of the World Bank, which sets out the World Bank's conflict of interest policy.

Consultants may associate with other firms in the form of a joint venture or a sub-consultancy to enhance their qualifications (the type of association shall be clearly indicated in the proposal). The Consultants may submit their Expressions of Interest as individual firms or in the form of a joint venture or sub-consultancy. However, the qualification of the sub-consultant will not be evaluated when forming the shortlist. In case of joint venture, all the members of the joint venture should individually meet shortlisting criteria and shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire assignment.

The Consultant will be selected in accordance with the CQS (Consultant’s Qualifications Based Selection) method set out in the Procurement Regulations.

Additional information can be obtained at the address below during business hours from 09:00 to 18:00 (local time).

Expressions of interest must be delivered in writing to the address below (in person or by e-mail) by June 1, 2026, 18:00 hours (local time).

Сlimate Resilient Water Services Project Implementation Unit of the Water Resources Service under the Ministry of Water Resources, Agriculture and Processing Industry of the Kyrgyz Republic

Kyrgyz Republic, Bishkek,
